notes: Autoregressive policy over QueST tokens (causal temporal convolution + causal transformer encoder, H_a=32 downsampled 4x to 8 tokens, FSQ [8,5,5,5]). The tokenizer is pre-trained (60k steps), frozen, and decoded with all 8 tokens. Batch size is per GPU; the reference trains 4 x 256. Identical to the oat preset except for the tokenizer.
